description: This file implements acceleration enrichment calculations for fuel correction strategies in an engine control system, including classes for wall fuel management and acceleration enrichment logic, with functions for parameter adjustments and initialization.

classes.name: WallFuel
classes.description: Handles fuel wall correction calculations based on fuel film and evaporation parameters.

classes.name: AccelEnrichmemnt
classes.description: Manages acceleration and deceleration enrichment logic, including buffer management and parameter calculations.

methods.name: WallFuel::reset
methods.description: Resets wall fuel data to initial state.

methods.name: WallFuel::adjust
methods.description: Calculates fuel correction based on wall fuel dynamics and engine parameters.

methods.name: WallFuel::getWallFuel
methods.description: Returns current wall fuel amount for a specific injector.

methods.name: AccelEnrichmemnt::getMaxDeltaIndex
methods.description: Finds index with maximum delta in buffer data.

methods.name: AccelEnrichmemnt::getMaxDelta
methods.description: Calculates maximum delta value based on buffer data.

methods.name: AccelEnrichmemnt::getTpsEnrichment
methods.description: Calculates enrichment based on TPS rate of change.

methods.name: AccelEnrichmemnt::getEngineLoadEnrichment
methods.description: Calculates enrichment based on engine load rate of change.

methods.name: AccelEnrichmemnt::onEngineCycleTps
methods.description: Updates buffer with TPS value each engine cycle.

methods.name: AccelEnrichmemnt::onEngineCycle
methods.description: Updates buffer with engine load value each engine cycle.
